identificationModule.briefTitle: Cisplatin and S-1 With or Without Nimotuzumab in Untreated Advanced Gastric Adenocarcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Cisplatin and S-1 With or Without Nimotuzumab for Patients With Previously Untreated Advanced Gastric Adenocarcinoma: a Single-center, Randomised, Open-label, Parallel-group, Controlled Phase 2 Clinical Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
In this open-label, single-center, small sample size, randomised, parallel-group, controlled study, the investigators aim to assess efficacy and safety of addition of nimotuzumab to CS chemotherapy in patients with previously untreated advanced gastric adenocarcinoma. Sixty-two patients are required and randomly assigned (1:1) to each group.

The control regimen (CS chemotherapy) is recommended as the standard first-line regimen for advanced adenocarcinoma of the stomach or gastroesophageal junction in japan.

interventions.name: nimotuzumab
interventions.description: nimotuzumab 200mg infusion on day 1,8,15 every 3 weeks

interventions.name: cisplatin
interventions.description: cisplatin: 30 mg/m2 iv. infusion on day 1, 2 every 3 weeks

interventions.name: S-1
interventions.description: S-1: 40 mg/m2 bid , 2 weeks on, 1 week off ；

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate as measured by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to progression as measured by RECIST 1.1
Treatment safety and toxicity as measured by Common Toxicity Criteria for Adverse Effects(CTCAE 3.0)

locations.facility: Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences
